shellCommands.command: ls -la && echo "---PACKAGE---" && cat package.json && echo "---NEXT VERSION---" && cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'
find pages -type f 2>/dev/null | sort && echo "---SRC---" && find src -type f 2>/dev/null | sort && echo "---APP---" && find app -type f 2>/dev/null | sort

for f in pages/404.js pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/index.js pages/blog/index.js pages/blog/\[id\].js pages/api/posts/index.js pages/api/posts/\[id\].js components/* styles/* next.config.ts tsconfig.json; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; echo; done
ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null && echo "---NESTED---" && find node_modules/next/dist/docs/ -type f 2>/dev/null | head -100

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; echo "===== page.md ====="; sed -n '1,120p' 03-file-conventions/page.md; echo "===== route.md ====="; sed -n '1,160p' 03-file-conventions/route.md

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; echo "===== generate-metadata (head) ====="; sed -n '1,90p' 04-functions/generate-metadata.md; echo "===== not-found.md ====="; sed -n '1,80p' 03-file-conventions/not-found.md

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; echo "===== error.md ====="; sed -n '1,90p' 03-file-conventions/error.md; echo "===== generate-static-params (head) ====="; sed -n '1,70p' 04-functions/generate-static-params.md
cd /workspace && rm -rf pages components/AppProvider.js && echo "Removed. Remaining tree:" && find app components styles types.ts -type f | sort
timeout 240 npx next build 2>&1 | tail -45; echo "EXIT: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
rm -rf .next && git status && echo "--- pages dir gone? ---" && ls pages 2>&1
